description: OracleDatabaseCloudVMCluster is the Schema for the OracleDatabaseCloudVMCluster API

apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object. Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and may reject unrecognized values. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents. Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to. Cannot be updated. In CamelCase. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: OracleDatabaseCloudVMClusterSpec defines the desired state of OracleDatabaseCloudVMCluster

backupOdbSubnet.description: Optional. The name of the backup OdbSubnet associated with the VM Cluster. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/odbNetworks/{odb_network}/odbSubnets/{odb_subnet}

backupSubnetCIDR.description: Optional. CIDR range of the backup subnet.

cidr.description: Optional. Network settings. CIDR to use for cluster IP allocation.

displayName.description: Optional. User friendly name for this resource.

exadataInfrastructure.description: Required. The name of the Exadata Infrastructure resource on which VM cluster resource is created, in the following format: projects/{project}/locations/{region}/cloudExadataInfrastuctures/{cloud_extradata_infrastructure}

exascaleDbStorageVault.description: Optional. The name of ExascaleDbStorageVault associated with the VM Cluster. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/exascaleDbStorageVaults/{exascale_db_storage_vault}

labels.description: Optional. Labels or tags associated with the VM Cluster.

network.description: Optional. The name of the VPC network. Format: projects/{project}/global/networks/{network}

odbNetwork.description: Optional. The name of the OdbNetwork associated with the VM Cluster. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/odbNetworks/{odb_network} It is optional but if specified, this should match the parent ODBNetwork of the odb_subnet and backup_odb_subnet.

odbSubnet.description: Optional. The name of the OdbSubnet associated with the VM Cluster for IP allocation. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/odbNetworks/{odb_network}/odbSubnets/{odb_subnet}

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

properties.description: Optional. Various properties of the VM Cluster.

cpuCoreCount.description: Required. Number of enabled CPU cores.

dataStorageSizeTb.description: Optional. The data disk group size to be allocated in TBs.

diagnosticsDataCollectionOptions.description: Optional. Data collection options for diagnostics.

diagnosticsEventsEnabled.description: Optional. Indicates whether diagnostic collection is enabled for the VM cluster

healthMonitoringEnabled.description: Optional. Indicates whether health monitoring is enabled for the VM cluster

incidentLogsEnabled.description: Optional. Indicates whether incident logs and trace collection are enabled for the VM cluster

hostnamePrefix.description: Optional. Prefix for VM cluster host names.

licenseType.description: Required. License type of VM Cluster.

ocpuCount.description: Optional. OCPU count per VM. Minimum is 0.1.

sshPublicKeys.description: Optional. SSH public keys to be stored with cluster.

systemVersion.description: Optional. Operating system version of the image.

timeZone.description: Optional. Time zone of VM Cluster to set. Defaults to UTC if not specified.

id.description: IANA Time Zone Database time zone. For example "America/New_York".

version.description: Optional. IANA Time Zone Database version number. For example "2019a".

vmBackupStorageType.description: Optional. Specifies whether VM backups are stored on local DB server storage or Exascale storage.

vmFileSystemStorageType.description: Optional. Specifies whether VM file system storage / VM images are stored on local DB server storage or Exascale storage.

resourceID.description: The OracleDatabaseCloudVMCluster name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

status.description: OracleDatabaseCloudVMClusterStatus defines the config connector machine state of OracleDatabaseCloudVMCluster

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the object's current state.

lastTransitionTime.description: Last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

message.description: Human-readable message indicating details about last transition.

reason.description: Unique, one-word, CamelCase reason for the condition's last transition.

status.description: Status is the status of the condition. Can be True, False, Unknown.

type.description: Type is the type of the condition.

externalRef.description: A unique specifier for the OracleDatabaseCloudVMCluster resource in GCP.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the generation of the resource that was most recently observed by the Config Connector controller. If this is equal to metadata.generation, then that means that the current reported status reflects the most recent desired state of the resource.

observedState.description: ObservedState is the state of the resource as most recently observed in GCP.

createTime.description: Output only. The date and time that the VM cluster was created.

gcpOracleZone.description: Output only. The GCP Oracle zone where Oracle CloudVmCluster is hosted. This will be the same as the gcp_oracle_zone of the CloudExadataInfrastructure. Example: us-east4-b-r2.

identityConnector.description: Output only. The identity connector details which will allow OCI to securely access the resources in the customer project.

connectionState.description: Output only. The connection state of the identity connector.

serviceAgentEmail.description: Output only. A google managed service account on which customers can grant roles to access resources in the customer project. Example: `p176944527254-55-75119d87fd8f@gcp-sa-oci.iam.gserviceaccount.com`

properties.description: Optional. Various properties of the VM Cluster.

compartmentID.description: Output only. Compartment ID of cluster.

computeModel.description: Output only. The compute model of the VM Cluster.

domain.description: Output only. Parent DNS domain where SCAN DNS and hosts names are qualified. ex: ocispdelegated.ocisp10jvnet.oraclevcn.com

hostname.description: Output only. host name without domain. format: "<hostname_prefix>-" with some suffix. ex: sp2-yi0xq where "sp2" is the hostname_prefix.

ociURL.description: Output only. Deep link to the OCI console to view this resource.

ocid.description: Output only. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure ID of VM Cluster.

scanDNS.description: Output only. SCAN DNS name. ex: sp2-yi0xq-scan.ocispdelegated.ocisp10jvnet.oraclevcn.com

scanDNSRecordID.description: Output only. OCID of scan DNS record.

scanIPIDs.description: Output only. OCIDs of scan IPs.

shape.description: Output only. Shape of VM Cluster.

state.description: Output only. State of the cluster.

storageManagementType.description: Output only. The storage management type of the VM Cluster.

storageSizeGB.description: Output only. The storage allocation for the disk group, in gigabytes (GB).
